label: Java SDK 3.3.0
type: first entry in the Java SDK's own independent version family - kept separate from version:server-*, version:cbl-*, and version:sgw-* per the same product-independence pattern used for those
note:
Promoted at first sighting following the precedent set by version:cbl-3.3.0 (round 3, also recurrence-1-at-promotion) - version/edition enums are treated as low-cardinality, high-value closed vocabularies promoted on sight rather than held to the usual 2-file recurrence bar, same reasoning as the original edition:enterprise/community pre-minting. Marks the point the transactions feature was folded into the SDK proper, having previously shipped as a separate library.

Round 13: the id field above read 'sdk-3.3.0' - dots where this file's own path has dashes - in violation of the rule that a record's id mirrors its path. Extraction agents that copied the id faithfully produced an id no tool in the pipeline could resolve, so their correct behaviour registered as unpromoted debt; two of them flagged the drift in their notes and asked reconciliation to settle it. Nine of the thirteen version records had this defect and no other namespace had it. verify-registry-ids.py now checks it.
